opening.argument: The video presents a rummy application with distinct practice and cash-game options, registration screens, game tables, and displayed signup rewards. The narration expressly says, "You can play both practice and cash game" and advises viewers to "just play the game using your Sign up Bonus So don't play Add Money", directing use of the stated bonus without adding funds. Although it explains a withdrawal procedure involving an email address and Paytm mobile number, the evidence does not show that information was submitted, money was transferred, or harm occurred. The promotional title, reward displays, and the description's "investment your own risk" disclaimer do not by themselves establish deceptive conduct.
